factors.label: Souls (net worth)
factors.description: Team souls difference

factors.label: Kills
factors.description: Team kills difference

factors.label: Hero levels
factors.description: Sum of hero levels difference

factors.label: Last hits
factors.description: Lane + neutral creep kills difference

factors.label: Denies
factors.description: Denied souls difference

factors.label: Hero damage
factors.description: Damage dealt to enemy heroes difference

factors.label: Guardians
factors.description: Enemy Guardians destroyed minus own lost

factors.label: Walkers
factors.description: Enemy Walkers destroyed minus own lost

factors.label: Base Guardians
factors.description: Enemy Base Guardians destroyed minus own lost

factors.label: Shrines
factors.description: Enemy Shrines destroyed minus own lost

factors.label: Mid-Boss
factors.description: Mid-Boss rejuvenators claimed minus enemy's

factors.label: Open lanes
factors.description: Lanes where the enemy lost both Guardian and Walker, minus own

factors.label: Deepest push
factors.description: Most objectives destroyed in one enemy lane, minus the enemy's deepest

factors.label: Objective damage
factors.description: Damage dealt to bosses and objectives so far (siege pressure)

factors.label: Enemies dead now
factors.description: Enemy heroes dead at this moment minus own

factors.label: Enemy time dead
factors.description: Seconds enemies have spent dead so far minus own

factors.label: Enemy respawn time left
factors.description: Seconds until dead enemies respawn, summed, minus own

factors.label: Enemy souls lost on death
factors.description: Souls enemies dropped when dying minus own

factors.label: Enemy abandons
factors.description: Enemy players who left the match minus own

factors.label: Soul lead momentum
factors.description: Change in the soul lead between the two latest stats snapshots, per 5 minutes

factors.label: Carry concentration
factors.description: Richest player's share of team souls minus enemy's (style, not advantage)

factors.label: Rank advantage
factors.description: Average pre-match rank minus enemy's, in sub-ranks (ranked only)

factors.label: Draft scaling
factors.description: Sum of picked heroes' scaling index minus enemy's (late-game draft = +)

factors.label: Draft strength
factors.description: Sum of picked heroes' win rate above 50% minus enemy's

factors.label: Hero experience
factors.description: Average games each player had on their hero in the 30 days before, capped at 50, minus enemy's
factors.step: 5 more games each on their hero

factors.label: Player recent win rate
factors.description: Players' win rate over the 30 days before (pulled toward 50% when few games), team average minus enemy's

factors.label: Player farming history
factors.description: Players' average souls per minute over the 30 days before, team average minus enemy's

factors.label: Win rate on picked hero
factors.description: Players' 30-day win rate on the hero they picked (pulled toward 50%), team average minus enemy's
factors.step: 1 pp higher win rate on their hero

factors.label: Draft synergy
factors.description: How the picked heroes do together beyond their own win rates, minus enemy's

factors.label: Draft counters
factors.description: How the picked heroes do against the enemy's heroes beyond their own win rates

draft_priors: per match day, from the 30 days before it (2026-11-10: 30 days of matches before 2026-11-10; …)
